title: antilla trichophora
intro: Antilla trichophora, commonly known as Antilla gomphrophylla, is a flowering plant species in the family Apocynaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include the ability to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Antilla trichophora include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and cardiovascular protective properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
